reuse.why: Links through the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount helpers that the other providers already share, and plugs into the syncAccount dispatcher.

duplication.why: The link handler is a thin adapter; only downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the Akahu/Pluggy download body (token, post, error check, response mapping).

placement.why: Handler, download, server URL and provider list are where the tree keeps them, but SyncServerFintegraAccount goes into bank-sync.ts instead of its own types/models/fintegra.ts like the other providers.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to the other existing providers is a small adjacent type fix.

maintainability.why: Easy to own since it mirrors the sibling providers via the shared link helper; the redundant official_name and the copied download function are minor.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Account creation/upgrade, initial sync and notification go through linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is an openly copied provider download function, not reshaped to hide it.
